flaws.text: "Rules outside a planned project": "In an unplanned repository the review runs with the template's rules and language auto-detection only, and says so

note: Only r01#1 and r05#4 say the document's "template rules only" claim is wrong and give the real resolution chain. r06#2 disputes the same sentence but for a different reason (auto-detection off without a rules dir), so it is excluded. r02#0, r03#0, r07#0, r08#0 and r01#0 mention cwd/rules lookup only as a trust/root-split issue and do not correct the claim.
